claims.text: The revised provisional Bill contains draft anti-misuse safeguards for selective escalation, case allocation, conflicts, retaliation, electoral-data misuse, indirect evasion and funding-based political retaliation.

claims.limitations: The safeguards are proposed text, not current law. Their legal route, exact cross-references and practical effectiveness require further review.
claims.reviewer_action: Apply the validation record, constitutional stress test, public consultation and independent qualified legal review before considering introduction.

claims.text: The 2024 Supreme Court order in Dr. Jaya Thakur records an interim challenge to section 7(1) of the 2023 Act, the then Selection Committee composition stated by the Union, procedural concerns about candidate information, and the refusal of interim stay without a final merits determination.

authorities.title: Dr. Jaya Thakur and Others v. Union of India and Another, 2024 INSC 246
authorities.version_or_stage: reportable interim order; current final case status not verified in this record

claims.subsequent_history_checked: Not completed; do not characterise the order as a final merits decision or infer the current docket outcome.
claims.limitations: The order records submissions and an interim ruling. It does not prove partisan capture or decide the constitutionality of section 7(1) on the merits.
claims.reviewer_action: Obtain current Supreme Court case-status and any final merits judgment before finalising an appointment-reform Bill.

claims.text: The 2024 Supreme Court EVM/VVPAT judgment is relevant to any proposal to repeal section 61A of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 and move to paper ballots; it does not establish the user's allegation of recent EVM manipulation.

authorities.title: Association for Democratic Reforms v. Election Commission of India, 2024 INSC 341
authorities.version_or_stage: reported judgment; later procedural history requires a current check

claims.subsequent_history_checked: A 2025 official case record identifies the 2024 case as disposed and records later verification-related petitions; a full current-docket check remains required.
claims.limitations: The judgment evaluates the record before the Court. It is not a general technical certification and does not resolve every allegation or future vulnerability.
claims.reviewer_action: Before introduction, obtain independent technical, operational, disability-access, fiscal and State/UT capacity evidence for the paper-ballot transition.
